concerns.text: FR-016 and the spec edge case mandate that the N>50 guard 'reduces the state space size by a factor of 2'. T009 instead halves the episode count and keeps state space at 200 — a silent weakening of an explicit FR with no spec amendment. Task must implement the spec's mechanism or the spec must be formally amended.

FR-006 requires a TOST equivalence test (margin ±0.1) on the regression slope; T013 does include TOST for the slope, but FR-015 requires a TOST equivalence test (margin ±0.05) on (Heuristic − Full-Batch) mean; T013 only implements a one-sample t-test on heuristic bias vs theoretical noise variance — a different comparison AND a different test. FR-015's requirement is dropped.

FR-017 (Pareto frontier distance via weighted-sum scalarization with step 0.01, method documented in output) has no implementing task. The plan lists pareto_oracle.py but no task creates it; the mapping table does not list FR-017 at all. SC-002 and US-3 scenario 3 depend on it.

FR-014's noise sanity check (empirical vs theoretical noise variance, relative error ≤ 5%, run BEFORE advantage analysis) is not in any task's deliverable or verification. The statistical_report schema has a noise_sanity_check block but no task computes it or enforces the 5% pass criterion.

FR-005 requires graceful failure with exit code 1 and a 'ResourceLimitExceeded' message to stderr when limits are exceeded. T009 only monitors/logs to resource_log.json; no task implements or verifies the failure behavior.

FR-013 requires a full-batch variance estimate on the same trajectories as ground truth for heuristic validation. T010 only stores heuristic estimates; no task computes the full-batch estimate, undermining SC-003's ratio-based stability criterion.

FR-006 requires ≥ 30 independent runs per configuration. T012's sweep and its verification (len(data) >= 7*3*3*3) count configurations, not runs; no task enforces the ≥30-runs requirement, so the regression could be fit on 1 run per config.
Mapping table cites FR-011, FR-021–FR-023, FR-024–FR-027, none of which exist in spec.md (spec ends at FR-019). Fabricated traceability IDs must be reconciled to real FRs.

US-4 requires applying the heuristic to the held-out heavy-tailed set and comparing empirical sample complexity to the theoretical bound with deviation flagging. T014 only generates the set; T015's verification checks pass flags for distribution types but no task explicitly runs the heuristic on the heavy-tailed held-out set and reports the deviation vs the bound.

Tasks write derivation artifacts to data/derived/ (variance_expr.json, sample_complexity_bound.json) while the plan/data-model declare data/processed/theoretical_bound.json with a specific schema; no task produces the data-model-declared artifact. Align paths/schemas.
T002's verification uses json.load on empirical_results.schema.yaml (a YAML file); the command as written cannot pass. Use yaml.safe_load.
T087 and T089 are restatements of T008/T015 with no distinct deliverables — duplicate tasks that will double-count work; fold into T008/T015 or delete.
